newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan July chain store sales fall 2.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan July chain store sales fall 2.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Sales at Japanese chain stores fell 2.5 percent in July from a year earlier to 1.48 trillion yen, the Japan Chain Stores' Association said on Monday.
July sales rose 9.5 percent from June, the association said in a statement.
The survey covered 132 companies, and was conducted among 7,828 outlets, which was 197 outlets more than a year ago, it said.

Chain store sales were sluggish overall this month because there was one less weekend and also because of a nationwide outbreak of food-poisoning caused by the O-157 bacteria, which led to diminishing sales of fresh foods and leisure-related products, the association said.
